description: This file contains tests for the IRC protocol functions, including parsing IRC lines, sanitizing outbound text, validating targets, and splitting text. It uses the vitest testing framework.

methods.name: parseIrcLine
methods.description: Parses an IRC line into prefix, command, parameters, and trailing message.

methods.name: parseIrcPrefix
methods.description: Parses an IRC prefix into nick, user, and host components.

methods.name: sanitizeIrcOutboundText
methods.description: Sanitizes outbound IRC text to prevent command injection.

methods.name: sanitizeIrcTarget
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes IRC target strings, rejects control characters.

methods.name: splitIrcText
methods.description: Splits long IRC messages into chunks respecting size boundaries.
